definitions.explanation: The flat bone at the center of the chest that connects the ribs. An important anatomical landmark in medical and first-aid contexts.

examples.japanese: {胸骨|きょうこつ}を{骨折|こっせつ}した。
{心臓|しんぞう}マッサージは{胸骨|きょうこつ}の{上|うえ}を{押|お}す。
examples.english: For chest compressions, you press on the sternum.

examples.japanese: レントゲンで{胸骨|きょうこつ}に{異常|いじょう}がないか{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: They checked the X-ray to see if there were any abnormalities in the sternum.

notes:
{胸骨|きょうこつ} is the flat bone at the center of the chest. Most commonly encountered in medical and first-aid contexts.

ETYMOLOGY:
{胸|きょう} (chest) + {骨|こつ} (bone).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胸骨|きょうこつ}{圧迫|あっぱく}: chest compressions (in CPR)
- {胸骨|きょうこつ}{骨折|こっせつ}: sternum fracture
- {胸骨|きょうこつ}の{上|うえ}を{押|お}す: to press on the sternum

RELATED ANATOMICAL TERMS:
- {肋骨|ろっこつ}: ribs
- {鎖骨|さこつ}: collarbone
- {背骨|せぼね}: spine

FIRST AID:
In CPR ({心肺蘇生法|しんぱいそせいほう}), the {胸骨|きょうこつ} is the reference point for hand placement during chest compressions.
